info.name: INVENT-MAG API Documentation
info.description: Invent-MAG exposes a deliberately small REST API covering authentication, CMS content, and supporting endpoints. All other functionality is served by the session-authenticated web admin panel (`/admin/*`) and is intentionally not part of the API.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public registration, login, and tenant lookup, plus token refresh for authenticated clients.

item.name: Log in and receive an API token.

request.description:
Authenticates the user with email and password and returns a Sanctum
bearer token for authenticated API calls. Rate-limited to 5 requests
per minute per IP.

Revokes the current token and issues a new one with a one-day expiry.
Call this with the token you want to replace.

item.name: CMS Content
item.description: Public landing-page content served to the Astro marketing site at build time.

request.description:
Returns the landing-page copy (hero, features, pricing, CTA, footer)
served to the Astro marketing site at build time. Responses are cached
for 1 hour.
